vote.q: Day 12. Water is at zero, food lasts one day, and the horde reaches the fence in two. Where do we send the runners?
opts: Easy run. Bottled water in the back, and more fuel.
Never searched, so it could hold anything. Medium risk, no promises.
Never searched. Medium risk, and it could be a haul or a trap.
vote.how: Comment GAS, FAIR or MALL (or its emoji) on the Day 12 Reel. One vote per account, your last comment counts. Name a second place too, and if enough of you ask for it, a separate group goes there as well.

survivors.name: Sam
survivors.bio: Holed up in the old laundromat on 3rd Street. Hasn’t seen another living person in weeks.

survivors.name: Jaylozy
survivors.bio: Jaylozy joins as a Sharpshooter, ready to take the shot when the moment comes.

survivors.name: Tanny
survivors.bio: Tanny is a professional hiker who knows every trail, making them a natural Scout.
survivors.away_note: scouting Mill Street with Marco, to get eyes on the twins before the horde
survivors.away_back: Tanny and Marco watched the twins from a rooftop on Mill Street all night. The dead follow them in a column, and it is coming down toward the east side of the fence. Now we know where to hold. They weren't alone up there: a man named Elias had been on the next roof for weeks, watching the same two blue coats. He says he's the neighbor who made the first call. He followed them back and he's waiting outside the gate.
away_talk: They are gathering on Mill Street. A lot of them.
On a rooftop. We are fine. Stay off the radio.

survivors.name: Seth
survivors.bio: Seth manages e-commerce by day and knows his way around IT, so he's ready to keep the radios humming.

survivors.name: Gary Finklestein
survivors.bio: Gary ran a very specialty shop downtown. He knows every back door on Main Street and won't say how.

survivors.name: Adam
survivors.bio: Adam showed up at the gate with a toolbox and grease under his nails. First thing he asked was where the generator is.

survivors.name: Asa
survivors.bio: Asa is a doomsday prepper who swings an axe at the dead and suits up in full armor, because the apocalypse could use a little extra clank.

survivors.name: Gabe
survivors.bio: Gabe is a doctor who plans to keep the whole camp patched up, since the apocalypse is just a bad case of Monday.

survivors.name: Mateen
survivors.bio: Mateen swapped spreadsheets for seed packets and intends to keep the entire camp fed and green.

survivors.name: Jeremy
survivors.bio: Jeremy is a stranded soldier who has been waiting for orders for way too long and is ready to take the shot himself.

survivors.name: Victoria
survivors.bio: Victoria walked in alone from Hollow Creek with a cleaver on her belt. She can make a feast out of a can of beans, and she says the farm out there could feed everyone.

survivors.name: Francis
survivors.bio: Francis is a carpenter who knows where the good tools are hiding, and he'll build you a fort before the sun goes down.

survivors.name: Jack
survivors.bio: Jack is a gunsmith who hammers out blades by day and fixes up guns by night, so the undead get a close look at his work before they go down.

survivors.name: Carl
survivors.bio: Carl is an EMT (a Rettungssanitäter back home) who has seen every kind of disaster, and he's ready to patch up the survivors who are left.

survivors.name: Javier
survivors.bio: Javier was a soldier left behind from the evacuation, and he still wears his gas mask like the war never ended.

survivors.name: Quinn
survivors.bio: Quinn is a hunter with a shotgun and a head full of survival knowledge, and the zombies have started avoiding the woods.

survivors.name: Elder
survivors.bio: Elder keeps the old engines running and the grumbling loud, a wrench in one hand and a sigh in the other.

survivors.name: Shawn
survivors.bio: Shawn comes from a military background, so he'll be the one organizing the perimeter and barking orders at the zombies.

survivors.name: Ryan
survivors.bio: Ryan is a professional break dancer who can outmove any zombie, though the undead may still challenge him to a dance-off.

survivors.name: Officer Reyes
survivors.bio: Reyes chained the station doors in week two and lived in the basement on evidence-room rations. Still wears the badge.

survivors.name: Toast
survivors.bio: Toast shows up with an M240 machine gun and zero plans to be quiet about it.

survivors.name: Artemis
survivors.bio: Artemis is an electrician who loves apocalypse vibes and can wire anything to anything.

survivors.name: Weston
survivors.bio: Weston is a carpenter who will build you a fortress, then argue about the door hinges.

survivors.name: Ben
survivors.bio: Ben is a military radio operator who will keep the group talking, even when nobody asked.

survivors.name: Frost
survivors.bio: Frost is a plumber who knows exactly where the water pipes run and how to make them useful.

survivors.name: Joseph
survivors.bio: Joseph is a military medic who stays calm while everyone else panics.

survivors.name: Jeff
survivors.bio: Jeff is a mechanic who can fix any vehicle, as long as it isn't on fire.

survivors.name: Spenz
survivors.bio: Spenz is a sniper who never misses, mostly because nobody sees them coming.

survivors.name: Marco
survivors.bio: Marco is an expert hunter who knows how to track anything, living or undead.
survivors.away_note: scouting Mill Street with Tanny, to get eyes on the twins before the horde
survivors.away_back: He counted them at dawn before they came down: hundreds, and more every hour.
away_talk: They looked up at us. I swear they looked up.

survivors.name: Bob
survivors.bio: Bob is old but wise, has seen it all, and knows exactly which places still have supplies.

survivors.name: Amnic0re
survivors.bio: Amnic0re is a server repair tech who spent his spare time doomsday prepping, and now finally gets to use it.

survivors.name: John
survivors.bio: John is a paranoid mushroom grower and canning expert with a spear, a fear of the dead, and a lot of jars.

survivors.name: Vic
survivors.bio: Vic is a blacksmith with a taste for big rewards, aiming for the Hangar and maybe the Farm on the way back.

survivors.name: Steve
survivors.bio: Steve is a firefighter who discovered the fire truck still has water in it and shared the news with the scavengers.

survivors.name: Kim
survivors.bio: Kim is an electrician who's tagging along with wstonkiethsteward to keep the lights on.

survivors.name: Larry
survivors.bio: Larry wants to be a firefighter, rushing toward the flames and the zombies alike.

survivors.name: Hudson
survivors.bio: Hudson is an electrician who keeps the lights on, even when the dead come knocking.

survivors.name: Opeta Teo
survivors.bio: Opeta Teo is an archer who crafts his own bow and arrows and picks off the undead from a safe distance.

survivors.name: Johnny
survivors.bio: Johnny is an engineer who can fix almost anything, including the apocalypse.

missions.crew: Asa and anyone with two hands
missions.reward: Fence +25% (uses 12 scrap)
missions.done_note: The fence is doubled with car doors and scrap. It won't stop thousands. It might slow them down.

missions.crew: Mateen, Victoria and a guard on the barn roof
missions.reward: +60 food: enough to get through the winter
missions.done_note: The harvest is in. Victoria's already planning the menu.
missions.unlock_note: Something was waiting in the corn. Crawlers: no legs, and you don't see them until you're on top of them.

missions.done_note: Water is running from the old tower in the woods, down a patched line to the laundromat. Clean water, every night. And the crew didn't come back alone: a skinny dog that had been living under the tower followed them all the way down the line, and won't leave Kim's side. It needs a name.

vote.question: Day 4. The generator needs 10 liters of gasoline, and the radio says the dead are moving south toward the bay. Where do we go?

returned: Tanny made it back. From the overpass he saw them: a column of the dead filling the highway, heading for the bay. Three days out, maybe less.
story: Adam and Gary Finklestein walked south to Hollow Creek Farm to see if Victoria was right and came back with +12 food and +6 water.
Adam and Gary Finklestein filled their packs from the farmhouse pantry and the rain barrels by the barn.

The crops: two fields of corn and one of wheat are still standing. Cut before the first frost, that's around 60 rations, enough to get the camp through the winter. But something has been moving low in the rows, and Adam didn't want to find out what.

The water pump: the windmill still turns in the wind, but the pump rod is seized and the troughs are dry. Gary Finklestein thinks a good mechanic could free it in a day. That's 10 rations of water straight away, then 4 clean every night with no fuel.
Cattle tracks lead off through the broken fence into the woods. The greenhouse is full of seed trays. Victoria was right.
Tanny's report changes everything: the horde reaches the laundromat on Day 7. Two days to shore up the fence and find ammo.
The big choice: get ready for what's coming from the north (ammo from the Gun & Pawn, or fortify the fence), or stockpile at Victoria's farm (the windmill pump for water, or the harvest for food).

features.name: Roof garden
features.note: Mateen found scrap wood behind the laundromat and built a garden box on the roof. First greens in a few days.

highlights.title: Roof garden
highlights.text: Built a garden box on the laundromat roof from scrap wood. +2 food a night once it grows (from Day 7).

highlights.title: Bayonet spear
highlights.text: Down to 2 rounds, Jeremy took a bayonet from a crate at Pier 9 and lashed it to a mop handle with fence wire. Now he can hold the fence without firing a shot. +2 horde defense.

highlights.title: Boat hook and a camera
highlights.text: On the Pier 9 run for fence parts, Francis found a dockworker's bag with a working digital camera in it, and pulled a boat hook off the warehouse wall. Reach without a bullet. +2 horde defense, and the camp starts photographing every run.

highlights.title: The water cooler
highlights.text: Behind the police station's front desk, a water cooler, still full. +10 water.

highlights.title: The diner
highlights.text: Tanny and Francis broke off from the police squad and searched the diner. A sealed case of water under the counter. +6 water.

highlights.title: The diner
highlights.text: Francis and Tanny took the diner nobody had searched. A sealed case of water under the counter. +6 water.

highlights.title: The trade
highlights.text: Asa handed Sam his pump shotgun and took a red-handled fire axe. Asa doesn't go anywhere without an axe.

highlights.title: Victoria's kitchen
highlights.text: Victoria set up a cooking corner in the yard: a grill, a stock pot, a crate for a counter. And a sign with Gary's name crossed out.

highlights.title: Banned from the kitchen
highlights.text: Gary tried to bribe Victoria with something from his old shop for extra dessert. She banned him from her kitchen, and there's a sign.

highlights.title: Propeller club
highlights.text: In the back of Hangar 2, Frost found a broken wooden propeller. He sawed one blade down to a handle and wrapped it in pipe tape. Now he has a club.

highlights.title: Pitchfork
highlights.text: Weston walked out of the Hollow Creek barn with a pitchfork. Four steel tines, five feet of reach, and he never has to get close.

highlights.title: Welder's leather jacket
highlights.text: Jeff found a welder's leather jacket hanging in the Hollow Creek workshop. Heavy cowhide, made to stop sparks. It'll stop teeth too.

twins.case: Incident #0001, the first call of the outbreak. A neighbor on Mill Street, on the east side, reported two men in matching blue sport coats walking into traffic. Officer Reyes and his partner took the call. They cuffed one. The other bit his partner, case #3. By morning Mill Street was gone; by the end of the week, so was Oakhaven.
bio: Twin brothers from Mill Street. The first two people in Oakhaven to turn, and the first two the dead ever followed.
Scott's twin. Same coat, same walk, same night. Where one goes, the other is a step behind.
twins.rules: Always called 'the twins' or by full name (Ryan Tedeschi, never just Ryan: Ryan the Decoy is a survivor). They lead every horde from the front; they never change the odds and can't die except in a mission Sam chooses to put on the ballot.
